added_lines: . launch night: new free social club in clanmaurice area for 18-35 year olds . thursday 5 november at 8 pm. venue: buds family resource centre in ballyduff. all welcome – see posters in churches for more details. november – remembering our beloved dead mass for parishioners who died during the year will be held on friday 20 november 2026 at 7 pm in saint brendan’s church, ardfert . if you would like someone to be remembered and prayed for in this mass, who passed away within the last 12 months and whose funeral was not in our parish, you are welcome to drop their name into the parish office and we will happily include them in prayers at the memorial mass on 20 november. a candle will be lit on the altar in m emory of them all. all souls day (monday 2 november) . mass will be offered at 10 am in st brendan’s church, ardfert and at 7 pm in the sacred heart church, kilmoyl ey for all the faithful departed. november masses for the holy souls on the november lists will be held during november on wednesdays at 10 am in ardfert church and on mondays at 7 pm in kilmoyley church. please return your november envelopes for inclusion in these masses. if you do not have a box of envelopes, november envelopes are available in both churches . ardfert
